svg.text: What the instrument shows without opening any software
each indicator sits behind 1 kΩ (R70 to R73): 2 mA, readable without dazzling in the dark
readable on the spot, with the computer's screen out of reach
A short press on the button cycles four pages:
A long press places a timestamped mark.
The board always works attached to a computer, but that computer is sitting
three metres away. The four indicators answer, on the spot, the four questions
you ask kneeling in front of the tree: is it powered, is it
connected, is it measuring, and is anything wrong.
